goal: Live and new work never reads Nothing to do, State missing or Agent stopped: an unplanned workstream or nested workstream reads the Manager's plan move, and work a close released or a create made carries the Manager's start receipt. A receipt on a step a gate was linked in front of afterwards is no move of the Manager's, and an unplanned row is 0% done.
contains: Plan pending: Not started: nothing planned yet (0% done
Export area: Not started: nothing planned yet
Released by a close: Starting the next step
Released and left: Next step not started
Task closed under its step: Starting the next step
absent: Gate linked after create: Next step not started
Gate linked after create: Manager to start
diagram: [Operators] Send the notice: Starting the next step (p-c.2)
